stemMd: What is the purpose of the final paragraph’s examples of visitor circumstances?

options.label: A
options.textMd: To challenge judging engagement from reading length alone.

options.label: B
options.textMd: To prove that long labels are never useful.

options.label: C
options.textMd: To claim that observation cannot reveal anything.

options.label: D
options.textMd: To rank all visitors by intelligence.

options.label: E
options.textMd: To explain why the museum stopped displaying objects.

explanationMd: Knowledge, time and conversational preferences can lead to different reading behaviour. The examples show why one visible behaviour is not a complete measure of interest or seriousness. They support a flexible design rather than a single ideal visitor pattern.

distractorRationale.b: Some visitors choose the longer text.
